components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin

          title: Address

          maxLength: 255

        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'

          maxLength: 255

            leading '+' followed by 8-15 digits); national numbers default to the '+61' country code.

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:

          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            present it is used to compose the owner's salutation. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility;
            when structured fields are supplied 'addressLine1' (plus optional 'addressLine2') is
            preferred. On a response this is the composed, normalized address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when supplied. Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present it is appended to the composed 'address' after a single space. Stored and
            returned normalized.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a
            leading '+' followed by 8-15 digits); national numbers default to the '+61' country code.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be a 4-digit number valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used. The effective date must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or Sunday (whether supplied or defaulted) is rolled forward to the next Monday.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present, the
            owner's ageBand is derived from it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            has the same last name and postcode (they share a household); the owner is created as a
            declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Optional; defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans, as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 4
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household. It is the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, lower-cased) joined by '|' to the postcode, so owners with the same last name and postcode return the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key used for duplicate detection, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where normalizedTelephone is the canonical E.164 telephone, email is the trimmed lower-cased email (empty when absent) and householdId is the household identifier. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61412345678|jean@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that share the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Every owner starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 when householdSize is 3 or more, add 3 when the tenure since registrationDate exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 8
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, banded from membershipPoints as 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points) and 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region using the fixed table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not one of these.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing owner's last name and postcode while having a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: When possibleDuplicate is true, the id of the existing owner (the earliest match) whose last name and postcode this owner shares. Absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from birthDate against the registrationDate; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I implemented the `salutation` feature end-to-end. The endpoint is the single `POST /api/owners` create pipeline (tests read the value back via `GET /api/owners/{id}`), so `title` had to be accepted on input, persisted, and used to compose the read-only `salutation` on output.

Changes:

1. **OpenAPI spec** (`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`) — the DTOs are generated from this at build time:
   - Added an optional `title` input field to the `OwnerFields` schema (→ `OwnerFieldsDto`).
   - Added a read-only `salutation` field to the `Owner` schema (→ `OwnerDto`).

2. **Owner entity** (`model/Owner.java`) — added a `title` column with getter/setter so the value survives POST → GET.

3. **DB schemas** — added a `title` column to the `owners` table in all four dialects (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `postgres`, `mysql`); tests run on hsqldb with `ddl-auto=none`. Also fixed the hsqldb `data.sql` positional seed inserts (added a `NULL` for the new column).

4. **Salutation helper** (`rest/function/owner/Salutation.java`) — `of(title, lastName)` returns `title + " " + lastName` when a title is present, otherwise just `lastName`, matching the existing helper-class pattern.

5. **OwnerMapper** — mapped `salutation` via the helper. `title` maps automatically (same name) in `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` used by `BuildOwner`.

6. **ApplyOwner** (PUT path) — also applies `title` for consistency, so updates keep the field editable.

The test `coreComposesSalutation` (posts `title=DR`, `lastName=who`, expects `$.salutation == "DR who"`) passes, and it's the only test in the suite.
